slides.title: Math Symbols: A Team of Characters

rows: The team player who brings ideas together
The organizer who clears away what is unnecessary
The builder who makes an impact grow
The fair friend who shares equally
The mediator who keeps everyone balanced
The detective who uncovers hidden value

slides.caption: Each mathematical symbol has a human-like role: bringing together, clearing away, growing, sharing, balancing, or discovering.
slides.narration: Meet the human side of mathematics. Addition is the team player who brings ideas together. Subtraction clears away what we do not need. Multiplication grows our impact, division shares fairly, equality keeps us balanced, and square root acts like a detective uncovering hidden value.
